title: Seismicity and ground displacement
caption: Partial contextual reconstruction. A: external routine catalog, 16,046 located events and five Md>=4 stars. B: 114 leveling surveys (circles), 13 source-provided estimates (triangles), one source-provided reconstruction (cross), and daily GNSS through 20 March 2025; Historical estimates are not raw observations or reconstructions made here. C: all routine monthly counts and cumulative Md>0.2; March includes days 1--20 only. Routine events are not independent detections. Datum joining is an assumption; basemap and live snapshot differ from the publication. Depth colors: fixed 0–5 km, red to blue; magenta >5 km, no data clipping. S5 limits/ticks are printed; 1A endpoints are unlabeled and 0–5 km is an explicit approximation. Circle area law is an explicit display assumption, not recovered exactly. Missing magnitudes are crosses. Routine events are external context.
comparison_caption: External routine-catalog context and source-labeled leveling/GNSS observations. These earthquakes are not independent detections. Historical snapshot and datum differences remain.

title: Temporal evolution of seismicity
caption: Weekly counts and depth evolution of the sparse relocated subset. Weeks without own events are not joined as measured zeros. External routine counts use a separately labeled right axis. Geographic masks are explicit alternatives; no confirmed-hybrid markers are added. Provisional independent observations and processing; sparse coverage, unreviewed phases, calibration path sensitivity. Not established fault geometry or exact reproduction. The additional extended-cohort view uses separately numbered, independently rerun results. Magnitudes and SVD uncertainties were not inherited by integer event ID.
file_labels: Latest extended cohort: independently rerun, provisional
comparison_caption: Provisional weekly counts and depths from two overlapping own subsets. Sparse exposure is not a full-period rate measurement; spatial masks differ. Routine context has a separate axis.

title: Focal mechanisms of larger events
missing: SKHASH was executed: 76 automated first-motion measurements on 8 own events; 35 passed the provisional sign/SNR screen. Seven events lack eight stable polarities; the remaining event has a 186.158-degree gap, exceeding the unchanged 90-degree gate. No mechanism is returned. caption: Ring-sector and central/onshore focal-mechanism maps are not reproduced.

title: Recorded station availability
caption: 997 files, 26 station names and 8706.970 union channel-hours. Short interval markers do not imply full-period coverage. Earlier calibration/downstream cohort remains separately numbered.

title: Station locations
caption: Partial station inventory: 51 released identifiers audited against official study-period response epochs. Filled triangles: 42 official coordinate matches; open triangles: 9 released coordinates with unresolved epochs or channel codes. Two coincident-coordinate pairs remain distinct identifiers. No verified geographic outlier. Local WGS84 projection and clipped coastline; the original 48-instrument membership is not established. Colors distinguish broadband (red), short period (yellow) and accelerometer (white) instruments; no independent relief raster is available.

title: Location uncertainties

KDE uses Scott bandwidth in log10(error), an explicit display convention. Provisional independent observations and processing; sparse coverage, unreviewed phases, calibration path sensitivity. Not established fault geometry or exact reproduction. The additional extended-cohort view uses separately numbered, independently rerun results. Magnitudes and SVD uncertainties were not inherited by integer event ID.

comparison_caption: 90 and 80 conditional SVD solutions from alternative quadrants. Kilometer-scale errors are retained. Different subset counts do not establish improved absolute accuracy.

title: Magnitude calibration and frequency distribution
caption: Partial relocated-subset magnitude calculation: 65 own estimates, 40 matched routine Md anchors in panel A. 5929 response-corrected channel measurements, 1626 above 5 dB, 884 relative-amplitude equations. Mc=-0.0, b=0.866 +/- 0.110 from 41 selected magnitudes. Calibration comparison is not independent validation; sparse acquisition cannot establish population completeness or b-value. The additional extended-cohort view uses separately numbered, independently rerun results. Magnitudes and SVD uncertainties were not inherited by integer event ID.
file_labels: Latest extended cohort: independently rerun, provisional
comparison_caption: 65 and 67 independently inverted amplitude magnitudes. Routine duration magnitude is a calibration prior, not validation. Completeness and b describe selected, discontinuous samples.

title: Hybrid-event clusters
missing: S14/unclustered: no independent unclustered hybrid sample or validated family assignment. The three-template threshold scan cannot itself supply that class.
caption: Partial candidate-family analysis from original observations. Twelve strongest independent correlation crossings per E1/E2/E3 template are displayed with measured frequency index and horizontal amplitude ratio. Template assignment is not manual confirmation or validated clustering. The amplitude ratio is not called a relative magnitude because common propagation paths are unverified. These are not the published 70 events or their full-period history.
comparison_caption: Measured waveforms, frequency indices and amplitude ratios for the twelve highest correlations per template. These candidates are not confirmed hybrids or validated clusters.
